The 2026 FIFPRO Men’s World XI has been released, out of a total of 26 players shortlisted for the starting line-up. This was disclosed in a tweet by FIFPRO on Monday. World Cup winners Lamine Yamal and Rodrigo Hernandez made the list, while 2026 Ballon d’Or winner, Harry Kane, was notably absent. However, his countryman Jude Bellingham made the list.
